title: MLOps Engineer
summary: An MLOps engineer builds the platform and pipelines that take machine learning models from a data scientist's notebook into reliable production. They sit in a platform or ML team and handle model deployment, monitoring and retraining, much as DevOps does for regular software.
dailyDuties: Track experiments, register models and monitor drift with a tool such as MLflow
Deploy models as batch jobs or real-time endpoints
Containerise training and inference code and run it on Kubernetes
Build CI/CD pipelines that test and release models
Schedule training and data pipelines with Airflow or Kubeflow
Set up dashboards and alerts for model services
